description.value:
Homebrew: a real, directly castable duplicate of the Heal spell, reflavored and simplified for the "Healing Transformation" spellshape feat -- the real feat only appends a reminder note to your next-cast polymorph spell's description and doesn't add any healing of its own, so this exists as a standalone spell instead. Only the 1-action, touch, self-only mode is kept; the 30-foot/2-action mode, the 3-action emanation burst, and the vitality-damage-to-undead branch are all removed, since none of them apply to a self-only heal. Healing scales with your character level (half your level, rounded up) rather than spell rank.

You can take advantage of shapechanging magic to close wounds and patch injuries. You channel vital energy into yourself, restoring a number of Hit Points equal to half your level (rounded up) in d6s.
